name: @mizchi/dspec
description: Typed, executable specification toolkit built around Pkl
author: mizchi

scripts.check: pnpm run build && pkl eval examples/rbac.pkl >/dev/null && pkl eval examples/dspec.pkl >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs drift examples/dspec.pkl && node src/cli.mjs coverage examples/dspec.pkl && node src/cli.mjs score-app-profile-mutations --json fixtures/sample-webapp-profile-extended-scenarios.pkl >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs generated check examples/dspec.pkl && node src/cli.mjs generated check examples/sample-webapp-2026.pkl && node src/cli.mjs generated check fixtures/projection-holdout-single-locale.pkl && node src/cli.mjs generated check fixtures/projection-holdout-monorepo.pkl && node src/cli.mjs emit source-map --locale ja examples/dspec.pkl | diff -u generated/source-map.json - && node src/cli.mjs emit quickcheck examples/dspec.pkl >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs emit alloy examples/dspec.pkl >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs emit quint examples/dspec.pkl | quint typecheck /dev/stdin && node src/cli.mjs emit lean examples/dspec.pkl >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs emit source-map --locale ja examples/dspec.pkl >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs verify-generated --json examples/dspec.pkl >/dev/null && node src/cli.mjs verify-generated examples/dspec.pkl && node --test
